title: 第25章 民怨冲天直抵太上第26章 洪荒圣人齐出动
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第25章民怨冲天，直抵太上！“龙族祖龙愿燃烧龙魂，以龙珠化日，为洪荒带来光明，为人皇解忧！”
“龙族祖龙愿燃烧龙魂，以龙珠化日，为洪荒带来光明，为人皇解忧！”
“龙族祖龙愿燃烧龙魂，以龙珠化日，为洪荒带来光明，为人皇解忧！”
轰！
轰！
轰！
……
伴随着祖龙的声音响彻洪荒，洪荒中所有龙族、人族、妖族，以及各类修炼者，齐刷刷地看向东海的方向。
只见原本平静的东海，陡然间波澜万丈，浪涛惊天！
一条长万万丈，粗如山岳的龙影，口衔一颗巨大的龙珠自东海中冲天而起，同时，周身燃起混沌色的火焰，涌入那颗龙珠中。
随着混沌火焰的涌入，龙珠越来越大，光芒越来越亮，当那颗龙珠升到万万丈高位置的时候，龙影已经变得极其虚幻，
但是那颗龙珠，
却变成了直径万丈的烈阳，散发着刺眼的光芒——
龙珠所化的光芒，虽然比不得太阳光的十分之一，也没有阳光中所蕴含的热量，但却在一瞬间，燃起了洪荒所有人心中的希望！
光芒，
照亮了东海，迅速登岸，短短几个呼吸的时间，就照亮了大半洪荒，同样也照亮了被黑暗笼罩的朝歌！
在人皇殿内的帝辛，听到祖龙的声音后，心头猛地一颤——
扭头看去，
没有丝毫温度，但却异常明亮的光芒，自人皇殿紧闭的门缝中投射而入，顿时让帝辛心头一颤！
嘎吱……

在无数人的注视中，帝辛的身影出现在人皇殿门口，他看着天上那颗‘太阳’，心中感触万分。
“吾帝辛，以人道之主、人族人皇之身份，答谢祖龙大恩大德！”
说着，
帝辛面露恭敬，冲着祖龙的位置躬身行了一个大礼！
轰！
那一刻，
祖龙忽然感觉到，一股它之前从未接触过的恐怖力量，直接灌入它的体内，使得它即将燃烧殆尽、随时都有可能灰飞烟灭的神魂，瞬间稳定了下来。
之前说过，
除了女娲之外，其他圣人都当不起人皇一拜，因为人皇位及人道之主，理论上是和鸿钧、后土同一个级别的。
但现在，
祖龙以龙珠化日，燃起洪荒人族心中的希望，所以它的残魂，能承受人道之主的一拜！
而且在神魂即将湮灭的时候，被强大的人道之力灌入，保住了一线生机！
这时，
祖龙脸上露出一抹笑容，它知道自己赌对了！
随后它那虚幻的身躯直接消失，只剩下一颗巨大但却毫无温度的‘太阳’，悬挂在天空上！
这一刻，
无论是四海还是洪荒上的龙族，全都流下了热泪，仿佛在为祖龙的‘陨落’而悲伤！
与此同时，
洪荒大陆上无数修炼者，全都陷入了巨大的震惊中，紧接着整个洪荒修炼界都炸了——
“卧槽，什么情况，祖龙未死？”
content_en:
Chapter 25: Public resentment reaches the sky, reaching the Supreme Being! "The Ancestral Dragon of the Dragon Clan is willing to burn the dragon soul and use the dragon beads to turn the sun into the sun, bringing light to the ancient world and relieving the Emperor's worries!"
"The Ancestral Dragon of the Dragon Clan is willing to burn the dragon soul and use the dragon beads to turn the sun into the sun, bringing light to the ancient world and relieving the Emperor's worries!"
"The Ancestral Dragon of the Dragon Clan is willing to burn the dragon soul and use the dragon beads to turn the sun into the sun, bringing light to the ancient world and relieving the Emperor's worries!"
Boom!
boom!
boom!
…
As the voice of the ancestral dragon resounded throughout the ancient world, all the dragons, humans, monsters, and cultivators of all types in the ancient world all looked in the direction of the East China Sea.
I saw that the originally calm East China Sea suddenly became turbulent and the waves were shocking!
A dragon shadow that was thousands of feet long and as thick as a mountain rose from the East China Sea with a huge dragon ball in its mouth. At the same time, chaos-colored flames ignited all over the body and poured into the dragon ball.
With the influx of chaotic flames, the dragon ball became bigger and bigger, and its light became brighter and brighter. When the dragon ball rose to a height of tens of thousands of feet, the dragon shadow had become extremely illusory.
But that dragon ball,
But it turned into a blazing sun with a diameter of ten thousand feet, emitting dazzling light——
Although the light transformed by the dragon ball is not as strong as one-tenth of the sun's rays, nor does it have the heat contained in the sun's rays, in an instant, it ignited the hope in the hearts of everyone in the world!
light,
Illuminating the East China Sea, I quickly landed ashore. In just a few breaths, I illuminated most of the wilderness, and also illuminated Chaoge, which was shrouded in darkness!
Di Xin, who was in the Human Emperor's Palace, felt his heart tremble after hearing Zu Long's voice——
Turn around and look,
There was no warmth at all, but an extremely bright light was projected from the crack in the closed door of the Human Emperor's Palace, which immediately made Di Xin's heart tremble!
Crunch…
Under the gaze of countless people, Di Xin's figure appeared at the entrance of the Human Emperor's Palace. He looked at the 'sun' in the sky and was deeply moved.
"My Emperor Xin, as the Lord of Humanity and the Human Emperor of the Human Race, thanks Zulong for his great kindness!"
Saying,
Di Xin looked respectful and bowed to Zulong's position as a big salute!
boom!
At that moment,
Zulong suddenly felt that a terrifying force that he had never come into contact with before was poured directly into his body, causing his soul that was about to burn out and could be wiped out at any time to stabilize instantly.
Said before,
Except for Nuwa, other saints cannot be worshiped by the Human Emperor, because the throne of the Human Emperor and the Lord of Humanity are theoretically on the same level as Hongjun and Houtu.
But now,
The ancestral dragon turned into the sun with dragon beads, igniting the hope in the hearts of the ancient people, so its remaining soul can withstand the worship of the Lord of Humanity!
And when the soul was about to be annihilated, it was injected with powerful human power, saving a glimmer of hope!
At this time,
A smile appeared on Zulong's face, he knew he had made the right bet!
Then its illusory body disappeared directly, leaving only a huge but temperatureless 'sun' hanging in the sky!
At this moment,
Whether it was the dragon clan from all over the world or the ancient world, they all shed tears, as if they were grieving for the 'fall' of the ancestral dragon!
At the same time,
Countless cultivators on the prehistoric continent were all in great shock, and then the entire prehistoric cultivation world exploded——
"What the hell, the ancestor dragon is not dead?"
